verses.sloka: प्रशस्य तु प्रशस्तव्याम् सीताम् ताम् हरि पुम्गवः ।गुण अभिरामम् रामम् च पुनः चिन्ता परो अभवत् ॥५-१६-१॥
verses.transliteration: praśasya tu praśastavyām sītām tām hari pumgavaḥ ।guṇa abhirāmam rāmam ca punaḥ cintā paro abhavat ॥5-16-1॥

translations.english: Hanuman, the bull among monkeys, admired the laudable Sita and the virtuous Rama and once again began to lament.

verses.sloka: स मुहूर्तम् इव ध्यात्वा बाष्प पर्याकुलेक्षणः ।सीताम् आश्रित्य तेजस्वी हनुमान् विललाप ह ॥५-१६-२॥
verses.transliteration: sa muhūrtam iva dhyātvā bāṣpa paryākulekṣaṇaḥ ।sītām āśritya tejasvī hanumān vilalāpa ha ॥5-16-2॥

translations.english: Sagacious Hanuman, eyes dimmed with tears, thought for a short while on the plight of Sita and lamented
translations.hindi: आर फल-फूल खा कर सन्तुष्ट हो, प्रपने पति को सेवा करती हुई ठएरएक्रीपम्तढहएल्ड)मिफे पराउन होउउही ५hntRAhleGangotr Initiative । सेयं कनकवर्णाङ्गा नित्यं सुस्मितभाषिणी । सहते यातनामेतामनर्धानामभागिनी

verses.sloka: मान्या गुरु विनीतस्य लक्ष्मणस्य गुरु प्रिया ।यदि सीता अपि दुह्ख आर्ता कालो हि दुरतिक्रमः ॥५-१६-३॥
verses.transliteration: mānyā guru vinītasya lakṣmaṇasya guru priyā ।yadi sītā api duhkha ārtā kālo hi duratikramaḥ ॥5-16-3॥

translations.english: "If Sita, who is worshipped by righteous Lakshmana and loved by Rama is tortured like this, it shows it is difficult to trangress the force of time.

verses.sloka: रामस्य व्यवसायज्ञा लक्ष्मणस्य च धीमतः ।न अत्यर्थम् क्षुभ्यते देवी गन्गा इव जलद आगमे ॥५-१६-४॥
verses.transliteration: rāmasya vyavasāyajñā lakṣmaṇasya ca dhīmataḥ ।na atyartham kṣubhyate devī gangā iva jalada āgame ॥5-16-4॥

translations.english: "Just as river Ganga is not agitated by the rainbearing clouds, this Sita is not perturbed as she is aware of the prowess of Rama and might of Lakshmana.

verses.sloka: तुल्य शील वयो वृत्ताम् तुल्य अभिजन लक्षणाम् ।राघवो अर्हति वैदेहीम् तम् च इयम् असित ईक्षणा ॥५-१६-५॥
verses.transliteration: tulya śīla vayo vṛttām tulya abhijana lakṣaṇām ।rāghavo arhati vaidehīm tam ca iyam asita īkṣaṇā ॥5-16-5॥

translations.english: "Sri Rama matches Vaidehi perfectly in character, age, behaviour, birth and auspicious signs. She is aware that he is the right person for her. Rama deserves Vaidehi and this blackeyed lady deserves him."

verses.sloka: ताम् दृष्ट्वा नव हेम आभाम् लोक कान्ताम् इव श्रियम् ।जगाम मनसा रामम् वचनम् च इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥५-१६-६॥
verses.transliteration: tām dṛṣṭvā nava hema ābhām loka kāntām iva śriyam ।jagāma manasā rāmam vacanam ca idam abravīt ॥5-16-6॥

translations.english: On seeing her glowing like fresh gold resembling goddess Lakshmi who is dear to the entire world, and thinking of Rama, Hanuman said:

verses.sloka: अस्या हेतोर् विशाल अक्ष्या हतो वाली महा बलः ।रावण प्रतिमो वीर्ये कबन्धः च निपातितः ॥५-१६-७॥
verses.transliteration: asyā hetor viśāla akṣyā hato vālī mahā balaḥ ।rāvaṇa pratimo vīrye kabandhaḥ ca nipātitaḥ ॥5-16-7॥

translations.english: "It was for the sake of this largeeyed Sita that the powerful Vali and the heroic Kabandha who was equal to Ravana in heroism were killed.

verses.sloka: विराधः च हतः सम्ख्ये राक्षसो भीम विक्रमः ।वने रामेण विक्रम्य महा इन्द्रेण इव शम्बरः ॥५-१६-८॥
verses.transliteration: virādhaḥ ca hataḥ samkhye rākṣaso bhīma vikramaḥ ।vane rāmeṇa vikramya mahā indreṇa iva śambaraḥ ॥5-16-8॥

translations.english: "Rama killed Viradha of fearsome valour in the forest like Sambara by Indra.

verses.sloka: चतुर् दश सहस्राणि रक्षसाम् भीम कर्मणाम् ।निहतानि जन स्थाने शरैर् अग्नि शिख उपमैः ॥५-१६-९॥
verses.transliteration: catur daśa sahasrāṇi rakṣasām bhīma karmaṇām ।nihatāni jana sthāne śarair agni śikha upamaiḥ ॥5-16-9॥

translations.english: Fourteen thousand demons of terrible deeds were slain at Janasthana by arrows resembling tongues of fire.

verses.sloka: करः च निहतः सम्ख्ये त्रिशिराः च निपातितः ।दूषणः च महा तेजा रामेण विदित आत्मना ॥५-१६-१०॥
verses.transliteration: karaḥ ca nihataḥ samkhye triśirāḥ ca nipātitaḥ ।dūṣaṇaḥ ca mahā tejā rāmeṇa vidita ātmanā ॥5-16-10॥

translations.english: "Ogres like Khara and Trisira and the powerful Dooshana were kileed in battle by Rama endowed with selfknowledge.

verses.sloka: ऐश्वर्यम् वानराणाम् च दुर्लभम् वालि पालितम् ।अस्या निमित्ते सुग्रीवः प्राप्तवान् लोक सत्कृतम् ॥५-१६-११॥
verses.transliteration: aiśvaryam vānarāṇām ca durlabham vāli pālitam ।asyā nimitte sugrīvaḥ prāptavān loka satkṛtam ॥5-16-11॥

translations.english: On her account Sugriva obtained the coveted kingdom ruled by Vali which was a difficult proposition, and retained supremacy in the world.

verses.sloka: सागरः च मया क्रान्तः श्रीमान् नद नदी पतिः ।अस्या हेतोर् विशाल अक्ष्याः पुरी च इयम् निरीक्षिता ॥५-१६-१२॥
verses.transliteration: sāgaraḥ ca mayā krāntaḥ śrīmān nada nadī patiḥ ।asyā hetor viśāla akṣyāḥ purī ca iyam nirīkṣitā ॥5-16-12॥

translations.english: "On account of the largeeyed Sita I ventured to cross the lord of rivers, the sea, and came to this city.

verses.sloka: यदि रामः समुद्रान्ताम् मेदिनीम् परिवर्तयेत् ।अस्याः कृते जगत् च अपि युक्तम् इति एव मे मतिः ॥५-१६-१३॥
verses.transliteration: yadi rāmaḥ samudrāntām medinīm parivartayet ।asyāḥ kṛte jagat ca api yuktam iti eva me matiḥ ॥5-16-13॥

translations.english: "Even if Rama turns this land stretching to the ocean upside down or even the entire world on account of her, it is justifiable, according to me.

verses.sloka: राज्यम् वा त्रिषु लोकेषु सीता वा जनक आत्मजा ।त्रैलोक्य राज्यम् सकलम् सीताया न आप्नुयात् कलाम् ॥५-१६-१४॥
verses.transliteration: rājyam vā triṣu lokeṣu sītā vā janaka ātmajā ।trailokya rājyam sakalam sītāyā na āpnuyāt kalām ॥5-16-14॥

translations.english: "The sovereignty over the three worlds will weigh less than one sixteenth part of Janaka's daughter, Sita.

verses.sloka: इयम् सा धर्म शीलस्य जनकस्य महात्मनः ।सुता मैथिलराजस्य सीता भर्तृदृढ व्रता ॥५-१६-१५॥
verses.transliteration: iyam sā dharma śīlasya janakasya mahātmanaḥ ।sutā maithilarājasya sītā bhartṛdṛḍha vratā ॥5-16-15॥

translations.english: She had risen from the land when tilled by the plough and was covered with auspicious paddy dust resembling the pollen grains of lotuses, this daughter of Janaka, the great righteous ruler of Mithila, This lady with unswerving devotion to her husband.

verses.sloka: उत्थिता मेदिनीम् भित्त्वा क्षेत्रे हल मुख क्षते ।पद्म रेणु निभैः कीर्णा शुभैः केदार पाम्सुभिः ॥५-१६-१६॥
verses.transliteration: utthitā medinīm bhittvā kṣetre hala mukha kṣate ।padma reṇu nibhaiḥ kīrṇā śubhaiḥ kedāra pāmsubhiḥ ॥5-16-16॥

translations.english: She had risen from the land when tilled by the plough and was covered with auspicious paddy dust resembling the pollen grains of lotuses, this daughter of Janaka, the great righteous ruler of Mithila, This lady with unswerving devotion to her husband.

verses.sloka: विक्रान्तस्य आर्य शीलस्य सम्युगेषु अनिवर्तिनः ।स्नुषा दशरथस्य एषा ज्येष्ठा राज्ञो यशस्विनी ॥५-१६-१७॥
verses.transliteration: vikrāntasya ārya śīlasya samyugeṣu anivartinaḥ ।snuṣā daśarathasya eṣā jyeṣṭhā rājño yaśasvinī ॥5-16-17॥

translations.english: "This celebrated lady is the eldest daughterinlaw of the noble, valiant king Dasaratha who never returned from the battleground without being victorious.

verses.sloka: धर्मज्ञस्य कृतज्ञस्य रामस्य विदित आत्मनः ।इयम् सा दयिता भार्या राक्षसी वशम् आगता ॥५-१६-१८॥
verses.transliteration: dharmajñasya kṛtajñasya rāmasya vidita ātmanaḥ ।iyam sā dayitā bhāryā rākṣasī vaśam āgatā ॥5-16-18॥

translations.english: "She is the loving wife of the righteous, grateful, wise and selfrealised Rama. She has fallen into the hands of these shedemons.

verses.sloka: सर्वान् भोगान् परित्यज्य भर्तृ स्नेह बलात् कृता ।अचिन्तयित्वा दुह्खानि प्रविष्टा निर्जनम् वनम् ॥५-१६-१९॥
verses.transliteration: sarvān bhogān parityajya bhartṛ sneha balāt kṛtā ।acintayitvā duhkhāni praviṣṭā nirjanam vanam ॥5-16-19॥

translations.english: "On account of her immense love towards her husband she has given up all kinds of luxuries, not caring for suffering. She was satisfied with fruits and roots in the desolate forest. Engaged in serving her husband, she experienced utmost joy as in her own palace. A lady of golden complexion who had not experienced suffering earlier is subjected to sorrow and is tolerating calamities in this way

verses.sloka: सम्तुष्टा फल मूलेन भर्तृ शुश्रूषणा परा ।या पराम् भजते प्रीतिम् वने अपि भवने यथा ॥५-१६-२०॥
verses.transliteration: samtuṣṭā phala mūlena bhartṛ śuśrūṣaṇā parā ।yā parām bhajate prītim vane api bhavane yathā ॥5-16-20॥

translations.english: "On account of her immense love towards her husband she has given up all kinds of luxuries, not caring for suffering. She was satisfied with fruits and roots in the desolate forest. Engaged in serving her husband, she experienced utmost joy as in her own palace. A lady of golden complexion who had not experienced suffering earlier is subjected to sorrow and is tolerating calamities in this way

verses.sloka: सा इयम् कनक वर्ण अन्गी नित्यम् सुस्मित भाषिणी ।सहते यातनाम् एताम् अनर्थानाम् अभागिनी ॥५-१६-२१॥
verses.transliteration: sā iyam kanaka varṇa angī nityam susmita bhāṣiṇī ।sahate yātanām etām anarthānām abhāginī ॥5-16-21॥

translations.english: "On account of her immense love towards her husband she has given up all kinds of luxuries, not caring for suffering. She was satisfied with fruits and roots in the desolate forest. Engaged in serving her husband, she experienced utmost joy as in her own palace. A lady of golden complexion who had not experienced suffering earlier is subjected to sorrow and is tolerating calamities in this way
translations.hindi: जिसने कभी कोई विपत्ति नहीं झेली, जो सदा हसमुख बनी रहती थी, वही यह सुवणं सदृश वणं वाली सीता, कष्टों रौर भ्रनर्थो को भोग रहीं! है

verses.sloka: इमाम् तु शील सम्पन्नाम् द्रष्टुम् इच्चति राघवः ।रावणेन प्रमथिताम् प्रपाम् इव पिपासितः ॥५-१६-२२॥
verses.transliteration: imām tu śīla sampannām draṣṭum iccati rāghavaḥ ।rāvaṇena pramathitām prapām iva pipāsitaḥ ॥5-16-22॥

translations.english: "Rama deserves to see her.Just as a thirsty man longs for the source of water, Rama pines for this highly virtuous lady who is tormented by Ravana.
translations.hindi: रावण द्वारा सताई हुई इस सुशीला जानकी को देखने के लिए श्री रामचन्द्रजी उसी तरह उत्सुक हैँ जिस तरह पौशाला देखने को प्यासाः उत्सुक हुआ करता है

verses.sloka: अस्या नूनम् पुनर् लाभाद् राघवः प्रीतिम् एष्यति ।राजा राज्य परिभ्रष्टः पुनः प्राप्य इव मेदिनीम् ॥५-१६-२३॥
verses.transliteration: asyā nūnam punar lābhād rāghavaḥ prītim eṣyati ।rājā rājya paribhraṣṭaḥ punaḥ prāpya iva medinīm ॥5-16-23॥

translations.english: "Just as a king who had lost his kingdom feels happy on regaining it, surely Raghava will feel exhilarated when he gets her back.
translations.hindi: निश्चय ही इसको पुनः पाकर श्रीरामचन्द्रजी. वैसे ही प्रसन्न होंगे; जेसे खोये हुए राज्य को प्राप्त कर राजा प्रसन्न होता है

verses.sloka: काम भोगैः परित्यक्ता हीना बन्धु जनेन च ।धारयति आत्मनो देहम् तत् समागम कान्क्षिणी ॥५-१६-२४॥
verses.transliteration: kāma bhogaiḥ parityaktā hīnā bandhu janena ca ।dhārayati ātmano deham tat samāgama kānkṣiṇī ॥5-16-24॥

translations.english: Deprived of all sensual pleasures, and separated from her relatives, she is surviving with the hope of meeting them.
translations.hindi: माला चन्दनादि सुख-भोगों से वञ्चित श्रौर बन्बुवान्धवों से रहित यह जानकी श्रीरामचन्द्रजी से मिलने की श्राया ही से प्राण धारण किए हुए है

verses.sloka: न एषा पश्यति राक्षस्यो न इमान् पुष्प फल द्रुमान् ।एकस्थ हृदया नूनम् रामम् एव अनुपश्यति ॥५-१६-२५॥
verses.transliteration: na eṣā paśyati rākṣasyo na imān puṣpa phala drumān ।ekastha hṛdayā nūnam rāmam eva anupaśyati ॥5-16-25॥

translations.english: She is looking at neither the shedemons nor these trees full of flowers and fruits. She is surely thinking of Rama with a singleminded attention.
translations.hindi: न तो ये राक्षसियों को श्रौर न फले-फूले इन वृक्षों की श्रोर देखती है । यह तो एकाग्र मन से केवल श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के ध्यान ही में मग्न, है

verses.sloka: भर्ता नाम परम् नार्या भूषणम् भूषणाद् अपि ।एषा हि रहिता तेन शोभन अर्हा न शोभते ॥५-१६-२६॥
verses.transliteration: bhartā nāma param nāryā bhūṣaṇam bhūṣaṇād api ।eṣā hi rahitā tena śobhana arhā na śobhate ॥5-16-26॥

translations.english: "Indeed, the husband is the greatest ornament for a married woman. Hence though deserving adornment she does not like it, bereft of her husband who is her only ornament.
translations.hindi: क्योंकि स्त्रियों के लिए उनका पति ही भूषण है, बल्कि भूषण से भी बढ़ कर ही है । प्रतः यह पतिवियोग के कारण, शोभा योग्य होने पर भी, शोभायमान नहीं हो रही है

verses.sloka: दुष्करम् कुरुते रामो हीनो यद् अनया प्रभुः ।धारयति आत्मनो देहम् न दुह्खेन अवसीदति ॥५-१६-२७॥
verses.transliteration: duṣkaram kurute rāmo hīno yad anayā prabhuḥ ।dhārayati ātmano deham na duhkhena avasīdati ॥5-16-27॥

translations.english: "Lord Rama indeed performs a difficult task in surviving without her. That he is not feeling despondent is a wonder.
translations.hindi: इसके पति श्रीरामचन्द्रजी इसके वियोग में भी जीते हें; सो सचमुच वे म्यह बड़ा दुष्कर कार्य कर रहे हँ

verses.sloka: इमाम् असित केश अन्ताम् शत पत्र निभ ईक्षणाम् ।सुख अर्हाम् दुःखिताम् ज्~आत्वा मम अपि व्यथितम् मनः ॥५-१६-२८॥
verses.transliteration: imām asita keśa antām śata patra nibha īkṣaṇām ।sukha arhām duḥkhitām j~ātvā mama api vyathitam manaḥ ॥5-16-28॥

translations.english: Sita who is endowed with beautiful dark hair and eyes like a hundredpetalled lotus, who deserves to be happy is in sorrow. I grieve to see her in this state.
translations.hindi: काले केशवाली, कमलनयनी श्रौर सुख भोगने योग्य इस जानकी को दुःखी देख, मेरा भी कलेजा मारे दु:ख के फटा जाता है

verses.sloka: क्षिति क्षमा पुष्कर सम्निभ अक्षी ।या रक्षिता राघव लक्ष्मणाभ्याम् ।सा राक्षसीभिर् विकृत ईक्षणाभिः ।सम्रक्ष्यते सम्प्रति वृक्ष मूले ॥५-१६-२९॥
verses.transliteration: kṣiti kṣamā puṣkara samnibha akṣī ।yā rakṣitā rāghava lakṣmaṇābhyām ।sā rākṣasībhir vikṛta īkṣaṇābhiḥ ।samrakṣyate samprati vṛkṣa mūle ॥5-16-29॥

translations.english: She who has beautiful eyes like lotus petals, was protected by the arms of both Rama and Lakshmna, who is tolerant like the earth and is guarded by the female demons of hideous appearance under a tree.

verses.sloka: हिम हत नलिनी इव नष्ट शोभा ।व्यसन परम्परया निपीड्यमाना ।सह चर रहिता इव चक्र वाकी ।जनक सुता कृपणाम् दशाम् प्रपन्ना ॥५-१६-३०॥
verses.transliteration: hima hata nalinī iva naṣṭa śobhā ।vyasana paramparayā nipīḍyamānā ।saha cara rahitā iva cakra vākī ।janaka sutā kṛpaṇām daśām prapannā ॥5-16-30॥

translations.english: "Deprived of her charm, she resembles a lotuscreeper blasted by frost. This daughter of Janaka has reached a pitiable condition afflicted by series of calamities. She resembles a famale Chakravaka separated from her mate.
translations.hindi: “पाठान्तरे--“एषा तु रहिता ।” । : सग: ७4 सीता, पाले की मारी कमलिनी की तरह, दुःखों से उत्पीडित हो तथा बकवा से रहित चकवी की तरह, शोच्यं दशा को प्राप्त हुई है

verses.sloka: अस्या हि पुष्प अवनत अग्र शाखाः ।शोकम् दृढम् वै जनयति अशोकाः ।हिम व्यपायेन च शीतरश्मिः ।रभ्युत्थितो न एक सहस्र रश्मिः ॥५-१६-३१॥
verses.transliteration: asyā hi puṣpa avanata agra śākhāḥ ।śokam dṛḍham vai janayati aśokāḥ ।hima vyapāyena ca śītaraśmiḥ ।rabhyutthito na eka sahasra raśmiḥ ॥5-16-31॥

translations.english: "The top branches of Ashoka trees bent down with blossoms and the Moon rising with thousands of cool rays at the end of winter (when spring sets in) beholding which she should be delighted intensfy her sorrow."
translations.hindi: फलों के भार से झुकी हुई भ्रशोक-वृक्ष की ये डालियाँ. और वसन्तः कालीन यह निर्मल और सूर्यं की ग्रपेक्षा मन्द किरणों वाला यह चन्द्रमा, इस देवी के शोक को प्रौर मी प्रधिक बढ़ा रहे हे

verses.sloka: इति एवम् अर्थम् कपिर् अन्ववेक्ष्य ।सीता इयम् इति एव निविष्ट बुद्धिः ।सम्श्रित्य तस्मिन् निषसाद वृक्षे ।बली हरीणाम् ऋषभः तरस्वी ॥५-१६-३२॥
verses.transliteration: iti evam artham kapir anvavekṣya ।sītā iyam iti eva niviṣṭa buddhiḥ ।samśritya tasmin niṣasāda vṛkṣe ।balī harīṇām ṛṣabhaḥ tarasvī ॥5-16-32॥

translations.english: Hanuman, the swiftfooted bull among monkeys, on his part waiting on the Simsupa tree thus reflecting concluded in his mind that she was Sita. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे षोडशस्सर्गः। Thus ends the sixteenth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
translations.hindi: । महाबीर कपिश्रेष्ठ हनुमान -इस प्रकार मन ही मन भली भाँति निश्‍चय कर कि, यही सौता है श्रोर श्रपना प्रयोजन सिद्ध हुश्रा देख, उसी वृक्ष पर झच्छी तरह बेठ गए
